rows.en: Module 2: The MHPSS Minimum Service Package
rows.ne: मोड्युल 2: मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोग (MHPSS) को न्यूनतम सेवा प्याकेज
rows.bt: Module 2: Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS) Minimum Service Package

rows.bt: Consultation and agreement among experts

rows.bt: Intersectoral – shared understanding, shared language
rows.note: Proposed missing recurring term: intersectoral = अन्तरक्षेत्रीय.

rows.en: Designed to facilitate a faster, more effective, better coordinated response
rows.ne: अझ छिटो, बढी प्रभावकारी र अझ राम्रो समन्वय भएको प्रतिकार्यलाई सहज बनाउन तयार गरिएको
rows.bt: Prepared to facilitate a faster, more effective and better-coordinated response

rows.en: 22 activities that are considered to be of the highest priority in meeting MHPSS needs in an emergency​
rows.ne: आपत्कालीन अवस्थामा MHPSS सम्बन्धी आवश्यकताहरू पूरा गर्न सर्वोच्च प्राथमिकताका मानिने 22 गतिविधिहरू
rows.bt: 22 activities considered to be of the highest priority for meeting MHPSS-related needs in emergencies
rows.note: The source count of 22 is preserved.

rows.en: when an emergency happens, we don’t need to start from scratch.
rows.ne: आपत्कालीन अवस्था आइपर्दा हामीले शून्यबाट सुरु गर्नुपर्दैन।
rows.bt: When an emergency occurs, we do not have to start from zero.

rows.en: We already have quite a lot of knowledge and evidence from emergencies around the world to help us in prioritising what to do. ​
rows.ne: के गर्ने भन्ने विषयमा प्राथमिकता निर्धारण गर्न हामीलाई सहयोग गर्ने प्रशस्त ज्ञान र प्रमाण विश्वभरिका आपत्कालीन अवस्थाबाट हामीसँग पहिल्यै उपलब्ध छन्।
rows.bt: We already have abundant knowledge and evidence from emergencies around the world to help us prioritize what to do.

rows.en: Intersectoral: key strength - a lot of diverse actors came together to provide input on the MSP, it had multiple different donors, and the involvement of many sectors – meaning it incorporates activities that are typically delivered by health actors, social welfare/protection actors, education actors and others​
rows.ne: अन्तरक्षेत्रीय: एउटा प्रमुख सबल पक्ष – MSP मा सुझाव दिन धेरै विविध सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू एक ठाउँमा आए, यसमा धेरै फरक दातृ निकाय थिए र धेरै क्षेत्रको संलग्नता थियो। यसको अर्थ, यसमा सामान्यतया स्वास्थ्य क्षेत्रका सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू, समाज कल्याण/संरक्षण क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरू, शिक्षा क्षेत्रमा कार्यरत पक्षहरू र अन्य पक्षहरूले सञ्चालन गर्ने गतिविधिहरू समेटिएका छन्।
rows.bt: Intersectoral: a major strength – many diverse stakeholders came together to provide suggestions for the MSP; there were many different donor agencies and involvement from many sectors. This means that it includes activities generally carried out by stakeholders in the health sector, those working in the social welfare/protection sector, those working in the education sector and others.
rows.note: Proposed missing recurring term: intersectoral = अन्तरक्षेत्रीय. The social welfare/protection grouping is retained.

rows.en: Designed to be helpful to coordinators, programme planners, donors, technical advisors and any other organization or individual implementing MHPSS activities with diverse backgrounds, qualifications and levels of experience.
rows.ne: विविध पृष्ठभूमि, योग्यता र अनुभवका स्तर भएका समन्वयकर्ताहरू, कार्यक्रम योजनाकार, दातृ निकाय, प्राविधिक सल्लाहकार तथा MHPSS गतिविधिहरू कार्यान्वयन गर्ने अन्य जुनसुकै संस्था वा व्यक्तिका लागि उपयोगी हुने गरी तयार गरिएको।
rows.bt: Prepared to be useful for coordinators, programme planners, donor agencies, technical advisers and any other organizations or individuals implementing MHPSS activities, with diverse backgrounds, qualifications and levels of experience.

rows.en: Looking very briefly at how the MSP was developed:
rows.ne: MSP कसरी विकास गरियो भन्नेबारे अति सङ्क्षेपमा हेर्दा:
rows.bt: Looking very briefly at how the MSP was developed:

rows.en: The first year of the project focused on the development of the content, through​​
rows.ne: परियोजनाको पहिलो वर्षमा निम्न माध्यमबाट विषयवस्तुको विकासमा ध्यान केन्द्रित गरिएको थियो:
rows.bt: In the first year of the project, attention was focused on developing the content through the following means:
rows.note: The introductory fragment leads into the following list.

rows.en: A literature review of key documents.​
rows.ne: प्रमुख दस्तावेजहरूको साहित्य समीक्षा।
rows.bt: Literature review of key documents.

rows.en: consultations through global networks for MHPSS and the relevant clusters & Areas of Responsibility. ​​
rows.ne: MHPSS का विश्वव्यापी सञ्जाल तथा सम्बन्धित क्लस्टर र जिम्मेवारीका क्षेत्रहरूमार्फत परामर्श।
rows.bt: Consultation through global MHPSS networks and relevant clusters and areas of responsibility.

rows.en: We had more than 100 participants in interviews and focus groups, in diverse locations and roles. ​​
rows.ne: हाम्रा अन्तर्वार्ता तथा केन्द्रित समूह छलफलमा विभिन्न स्थान र भूमिकाका 100 भन्दा बढी सहभागी थिए।
rows.bt: There were more than 100 participants from different locations and roles in our interviews and focus group discussions.

rows.en: We focused on getting input from colleagues implementing MHPSS in different emergency settings around the world as well as global and regional advisors. ​​
rows.ne: हामीले विश्वभरका विभिन्न आपत्कालीन परिस्थितिमा MHPSS कार्यान्वयन गरिरहेका सहकर्मीहरूका साथै विश्वव्यापी र क्षेत्रीय सल्लाहकारहरूबाट सुझाव प्राप्त गर्नमा ध्यान केन्द्रित गर्‍यौँ।
rows.bt: We focused on receiving suggestions from colleagues implementing MHPSS in various emergency situations around the world, as well as from global and regional advisers.

rows.en: The first draft was developed based on this work, and then it went through multiple rounds of peer review.​
rows.ne: यस कामका आधारमा पहिलो मस्यौदा तयार गरियो र त्यसपछि त्यसको धेरै चरणमा समकक्षी समीक्षा गरियो।
rows.bt: Based on this work, a first draft was prepared, and it then underwent several rounds of peer review.

rows.en: The MSP field test took place in 2021 & 2022- we got a lot of feedback, hundreds of surveys & consultations with users, and made quite a lot of revisions based on it’s use in the real world. ​​
rows.ne: MSP को स्थलगत परीक्षण 2021 र 2022 मा भयो—हामीले धेरै पृष्ठपोषण प्राप्त गर्‍यौँ, प्रयोगकर्ताहरूसँग सयौँ सर्वेक्षण तथा परामर्श गर्‍यौँ र वास्तविक परिस्थितिमा यसको प्रयोगका आधारमा धेरै संशोधन गर्‍यौँ।
rows.bt: Field testing of the MSP took place in 2021 and 2022—we received a lot of feedback, conducted hundreds of surveys and consultations with users, and made many revisions based on its use in real situations.

rows.en: The MSP was then revised and reviewed again and finally released as an IASC product in Dec 2022​
rows.ne: त्यसपछि MSP लाई संशोधन गरी पुनः समीक्षा गरियो र अन्ततः डिसेम्बर 2022 मा IASC को उत्पादका रूपमा जारी गरियो।
rows.bt: Then the MSP was revised and reviewed again, and finally issued as a product of the IASC in December 2022.
rows.note: The translation narrows 'IASC product' to 'IASC publication'; the revision preserves the broader product designation.

rows.en: Since then we have been supporting people to use the MSP and developing additional operational tools​.
rows.ne: त्यसयता हामीले मानिसहरूलाई MSP प्रयोग गर्न सहयोग गर्दै आएका छौँ र थप कार्यसञ्चालन उपकरणहरू विकास गरिरहेका छौँ।
rows.bt: Since then, we have been helping people use the MSP and are developing additional operational tools.

rows.ne: खण्ड 1 ले MHPSS प्रतिकार्यका लागि अन्तरनिकाय समन्वय र लेखाजोखामा ध्यान केन्द्रित गर्छ।

rows.en: Section 2 lists essential components of all MHPSS Programs. ​Elements that any organization engaging in any type of MHPSS activity should be working on.
rows.ne: खण्ड 2 मा सबै MHPSS कार्यक्रमका अत्यावश्यक घटक सूचीबद्ध छन्। यी त्यस्ता पक्ष हुन् जसमा कुनै पनि प्रकारको MHPSS गतिविधिमा संलग्न हरेक संस्थाले काम गरिरहेको हुनुपर्छ।

rows.bt: Section 4 includes 2 programmatic activities focused on specific situations.

rows.en: MHPSS MSP Activities
rows.ne: MHPSS MSP गतिविधिहरू
rows.bt: MHPSS MSP activities

rows.en: Here we see the activities in the MSP within their respective section.
rows.ne: यहाँ हामी MSP गतिविधिहरू तिनका सम्बन्धित खण्डमा देख्न सक्छौँ।
rows.bt: Here we can see the MSP activities in their respective sections.
rows.note: The recurring structural term 'section' is absent from the glossary; a proposal is supplied.

rows.en: This is just to show you how they fit within that structure. ​Don’t worry about reading it all now.
rows.ne: यो ती गतिविधिहरू उक्त संरचनाभित्र कसरी समावेश छन् भनेर तपाईंहरूलाई देखाउनका लागि मात्र हो। अहिले नै सबै पढ्ने चिन्ता नगर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: This is only to show you how those activities are included within that structure. Do not worry about reading everything right now.

rows.en: There is a lot of information here.
rows.ne: यहाँ धेरै जानकारी छ।
rows.bt: There is a lot of information here.

rows.en: We will dive into the different MSP sections and explore the activities within each section as we move along in the workshop.
rows.ne: कार्यशाला अघि बढ्दै जाँदा हामी MSP का विभिन्न खण्डबारे विस्तृत रूपमा छलफल गर्नेछौँ र प्रत्येक खण्डभित्रका गतिविधिहरू अध्ययन गर्नेछौँ।
rows.bt: As the workshop progresses, we will discuss the different sections of the MSP in detail and study the activities within each section.
rows.note: The recurring structural term 'section' is absent from the glossary; a proposal is supplied.

rows.en: So, again, just to give you an overview:
rows.ne: त्यसैले, फेरि एकपटक तपाईंहरूलाई झलक दिनका लागि मात्र:
rows.bt: So, once again, just to give you a glimpse:

rows.en: In section 1, we have the 2 activities focused on inter agency coordination and assessment​.
rows.ne: खण्ड 1 मा अन्तरनिकाय समन्वय र लेखाजोखामा केन्द्रित 2 गतिविधि छन्।
rows.bt: Section 1 has 2 activities focused on interagency coordination and assessment.
rows.note: The recurring structural term 'section' is absent from the glossary; a proposal is supplied.

rows.en: (1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors ; 1.2 Assess mhpss needs and resources to guide programming).
rows.ne: (1.1 क्षेत्रभित्र र क्षेत्रहरूबीच MHPSS समन्वय गर्ने; 1.2 कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनलाई दिशा दिन mhpss आवश्यकता र स्रोतहरूको लेखाजोखा गर्ने)।
rows.bt: (1.1 To coordinate MHPSS within the sector and between sectors; 1.2 To assess mhpss needs and resources to guide program formulation and implementation).
rows.note: The second activity follows the supplied activity wording while retaining the source's lowercase mhpss; T093 is not listed because its exact supplied form is not used. Activity 1.2 changes 'guide programming' to 'guide the programme'. The revision uses the supplied candidate for programming, preserving the process meaning and the source's lowercase mhpss.

rows.en: These activities are particularly relevant to TWGs/coordination groups, as they rely on interagency work.​
rows.ne: यी गतिविधिहरू विशेष गरी TWGs/समन्वय समूहहरूका लागि सान्दर्भिक छन्, किनकि यी गतिविधिहरू संस्थाहरूबीचको काममा निर्भर हुन्छन्।
rows.bt: These activities are particularly relevant for TWGs/coordination groups, because these activities depend on work between organizations.

rows.en: In section 2, we have 4 activities considered the essential components of all mhpss programmes (that is: effective program planning and design – 2.1; developing and implementing systems for M&E – 2.2; caring for staff & volunteers - 2.3; and supporting MHPSS competencies of staff and volunteers- 2.4).​ As we said before, these are things that any organization engaging in any type of MHPSS activity should be doing.
rows.ne: खण्ड 2 मा सबै mhpss कार्यक्रमका अत्यावश्यक घटक मानिएका 4 गतिविधि छन् (अर्थात्: कार्यक्रमको प्रभावकारी योजना र डिजाइन गर्ने – 2.1; M&E का लागि प्रणालीहरू विकास र कार्यान्वयन गर्ने – 2.2; कर्मचारी र स्वयंसेवकको हेरचाह गर्ने – 2.3; र कर्मचारी र स्वयंसेवकको MHPSS सम्बन्धी सक्षमतामा सहयोग गर्ने – 2.4)। हामीले पहिले भनेझैँ, यी त्यस्ता काम हुन् जुन कुनै पनि प्रकारको MHPSS गतिविधिमा संलग्न हरेक संस्थाले गरिरहेको हुनुपर्छ।
rows.bt: Section 2 has 4 activities considered essential components of all mhpss programmes (namely: effectively plan and design the programme – 2.1; develop and implement systems for M&E – 2.2; care for staff and volunteers – 2.3; and support the MHPSS-related competencies of staff and volunteers – 2.4). As we said earlier, these are tasks that every organization involved in any type of MHPSS activity should be doing.
rows.note: The recurring terms 'section' and 'essential components' are absent from the glossary; proposals are supplied. The source's lowercase mhpss and uppercase MHPSS are retained in their respective occurrences.

rows.en: Then we have section 3 (right side of the slide), which includes 14 programme activities.
rows.ne: त्यसपछि खण्ड 3 (स्लाइडको दायाँपट्टि) छ, जसमा 14 कार्यक्रमगत गतिविधिहरू समावेश छन्।
rows.bt: Then there is Section 3 (on the right side of the slide), which includes 14 programmatic activities.

rows.en: This is the main body of the MSP and it covers 14 programme activities, from community-wide messaging and supporting community-self help, all the way up to focused support like psychological interventions and care & protection for people in psychiatric hospitals and other institutions. ​We will zoom in on each activity further ahead in the workshop.
rows.ne: यो MSP को मुख्य भाग हो र यसमा 14 कार्यक्रमगत गतिविधिहरू समेटिएका छन्। यी गतिविधिहरू समुदायभरि सन्देश प्रसार गर्ने र समुदायको स्वसहयोगमा सहयोग गर्ने कार्यदेखि मनोवैज्ञानिक हस्तक्षेप तथा मानसिक अस्पताल र अन्य संस्थामा रहेका व्यक्तिहरूको हेरचाह तथा संरक्षणजस्ता लक्षित सहयोगसम्म फैलिएका छन्। कार्यशालाको आगामी भागमा हामी प्रत्येक गतिविधिलाई विस्तृत रूपमा हेर्नेछौँ।
rows.bt: This is the main part of the MSP and includes 14 programmatic activities. These activities range from spreading messages throughout the community and supporting community self-help to targeted support such as psychological interventions and the care and protection of people in mental hospitals and other institutions. In the upcoming part of the workshop, we will look at each activity in detail.
rows.note: Clinical wording reuses the cited unreviewed candidates T007 and T015; domain review remains pending. Proposals for the recurring terms self-help and focused support are listed separately.

rows.en: In Section 4 –(on the bottom, left hand side) we have the 2 program activities for specific settings.
rows.ne: खण्ड 4 मा (तल बायाँपट्टि) विशिष्ट परिवेशका लागि 2 कार्यक्रमगत गतिविधिहरू छन्।
rows.bt: Section 4 (at the bottom left) has 2 programmatic activities for specific settings.

rows.en: These activities will be relevant to you if you are working in a Public Health Emergency response to an infectious disease outbreak and/or if you are providing MHPSS for people deprived of their liberty .
rows.ne: यदि तपाईं सरुवा रोगको प्रकोपका लागि जनस्वास्थ्य आपत्काल प्रतिकार्यमा काम गर्दै हुनुहुन्छ र/वा स्वतन्त्रताबाट वञ्चित व्यक्तिहरूलाई MHPSS प्रदान गर्दै हुनुहुन्छ भने यी गतिविधिहरू तपाईंका लागि सान्दर्भिक हुनेछन्।
rows.bt: If you are working in a public health emergency response to an infectious disease outbreak and/or providing MHPSS to people deprived of liberty, these activities will be relevant to you.
rows.note: Disease wording reuses the supplied unreviewed activity 4.1 candidate; wording for persons deprived of liberty follows the supplied activity 4.2 candidate.

rows.en: If you work in such settings, the activities in this section would be applicable in addition to the activities in section 3.
rows.ne: यदि तपाईं यस्ता परिवेशमा काम गर्नुहुन्छ भने खण्ड 3 का गतिविधिहरूका अतिरिक्त यस खण्डका गतिविधिहरू पनि लागू हुनेछन्।
rows.bt: If you work in such settings, the activities in this section will also apply in addition to the activities in Section 3.

rows.en: MHPSS MSP Activities
rows.ne: MHPSS MSP गतिविधिहरू
rows.bt: MHPSS MSP activities

rows.en: No single organization is expected to implement all programme activities!
rows.ne: कुनै एक संस्थाले मात्र सबै कार्यक्रमगत गतिविधिहरू कार्यान्वयन गर्ने अपेक्षा गरिएको छैन।
rows.bt: No single organization alone is expected to implement all programmatic activities.

rows.en: Here we see the activities in the MSP within their respective section – just to show you how they fit within that structure.
rows.ne: यहाँ MSP का गतिविधिहरू तिनका सम्बन्धित खण्डमा देखाइएको छ, ताकि ती गतिविधिहरू उक्त संरचनाभित्र कसरी समेटिएका छन् भन्ने तपाईंले देख्न सक्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Here, the MSP activities are shown in their respective sections so that you can see how those activities are included within that structure.

rows.en: In section 1, we have the 2 activities focused on inter agency coordination and assessment
rows.ne: खण्ड 1 मा अन्तरसंस्थागत समन्वय र लेखाजोखामा केन्द्रित 2 गतिविधिहरू छन्।
rows.bt: Section 1 has 2 activities focused on inter-agency coordination and assessment.

rows.en: In section 2, we have 4 activities considered essential components of all mhpss programmes (effective program design, developing systems for M&E and staff care, and supporting and monitoring staff competencies),
rows.ne: खण्ड 2 मा सबै mhpss कार्यक्रमका अत्यावश्यक अङ्ग मानिएका 4 गतिविधिहरू छन् (प्रभावकारी कार्यक्रम डिजाइन, M&E र कर्मचारीको हेरचाहका लागि प्रणाली विकास, तथा कर्मचारीको सक्षमतामा सहयोग र त्यसको अनुगमन)।
rows.bt: Section 2 has 4 activities considered essential components of all mhpss programmes (effective programme design, development of systems for M&E and staff care, and support for and monitoring of staff competence).
rows.note: The source acronym casing mhpss is retained.

rows.en: Then we have section 3 (right side of the slide), which is the main body of the MSP, and includes 14 programme activities.
rows.ne: त्यसपछि खण्ड 3 (स्लाइडको दायाँपट्टि) छ, जुन MSP को मुख्य भाग हो र जसमा 14 कार्यक्रमगत गतिविधिहरू समावेश छन्।
rows.bt: Then there is Section 3 (on the right side of the slide), which is the main part of the MSP and includes 14 programmatic activities.

rows.en: Biggest part of the MSP, grouped into 2 sub-sections on orienting humanitarian actors & community members on MHPSS, Strengthening self-help (including community-led activities), focused support for people impaired by distress or MH conditions
rows.ne: MSP को सबैभन्दा ठूलो भागलाई मानवीय कार्यमा संलग्न पक्षहरू र समुदायका सदस्यहरूलाई MHPSS सम्बन्धी अभिमुखीकरण दिने; स्वसहयोग सुदृढ गर्ने (समुदायको नेतृत्वमा सञ्चालित गतिविधिहरूसहित); र व्यथा वा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य (MH) सम्बन्धी अवस्थाका कारण कार्यक्षमता प्रभावित भएका व्यक्तिहरूलाई केन्द्रित सहयोग दिने विषय समेट्ने 2 उपखण्डमा समूहबद्ध गरिएको छ।
rows.bt: The largest part of MSP has been grouped into 2 subsections covering the topics of providing orientation on MHPSS to actors involved in humanitarian work and community members; strengthening self-help (including community-led activities); and providing focused support to people whose functioning is affected because of distress or mental health (MH) conditions.
rows.note: The source specifies 2 subsections but lists three apparent thematic groupings; this inconsistency is retained rather than reconciled.

rows.en: Section 4 –the 2 program activities for specific circumstances.
rows.ne: खण्ड 4 मा विशिष्ट परिस्थितिका लागि 2 कार्यक्रमगत गतिविधिहरू छन्।
rows.bt: Section 4 has 2 programmatic activities for specific circumstances.

rows.en: As mentioned before, these are IDO and support for people deprived of their liberty.
rows.ne: पहिले उल्लेख गरिएअनुसार, यी IDO र स्वतन्त्रताबाट वञ्चित व्यक्तिहरूका लागि सहयोगसम्बन्धी गतिविधिहरू हुन्।
rows.bt: As mentioned earlier, these are activities related to IDO and support for people deprived of liberty.
rows.note: IDO is retained without an expansion not supplied in this row.

rows.en: Important! no single organization is expected to implement programme all activities.
rows.ne: महत्त्वपूर्ण कुरा: कुनै एक संस्थाले मात्र सबै कार्यक्रमगत गतिविधिहरू कार्यान्वयन गर्ने अपेक्षा गरिएको छैन।
rows.bt: Important point: No single organization alone is expected to implement all programmatic activities.

rows.en: Organizations must coordinate and work together across sectors and AORs to ensure that activities are implemented and that a comprehensive response is delivered in each geographical area.
rows.ne: प्रत्येक भौगोलिक क्षेत्रमा गतिविधिहरू कार्यान्वयन हुने र समग्र प्रतिकार्य उपलब्ध गराइने सुनिश्चित गर्न संस्थाहरूले विभिन्न क्षेत्र र AORs बीच समन्वय गरी मिलेर काम गर्नुपर्छ।
rows.bt: Organizations must coordinate across different sectors and AORs and work together to ensure that activities are implemented in each geographical area and that an overall response is provided.
rows.note: AORs is retained without adding an expansion.

rows.en: Now let´s see what an activity looks like in the MSP.
rows.ne: अब MSP मा एउटा गतिविधि कसरी प्रस्तुत गरिएको हुन्छ भन्ने हेरौँ।
rows.bt: Now let us look at how an activity is presented in the MSP.

rows.en: Each activity is presented with:
rows.ne: प्रत्येक गतिविधिसँग निम्न सामग्री प्रस्तुत गरिन्छ:
rows.bt: The following materials are presented with each activity:

rows.en: A brief introduction
rows.ne: संक्षिप्त परिचय
rows.bt: Brief introduction

rows.en: Each activity across the 4 sections comes with a set of tools to support planning and implementation, including:​
rows.ne: 4 वटै खण्डका प्रत्येक गतिविधिसँग योजना र कार्यान्वयनमा सहयोग गर्ने साधनहरूको समूह दिइएको छ, जसमा निम्न सामग्री समावेश छन्:
rows.bt: Each activity in all 4 sections is provided with a set of tools to support planning and implementation, which includes the following materials:

rows.en: A brief introduction explaining why the activity is important.
rows.ne: गतिविधि किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ भन्ने स्पष्ट पार्ने संक्षिप्त परिचय।
rows.bt: A brief introduction clarifying why the activity is important.

rows.en: Here you have as an example activity 3.6 (Provide group activities for children´s MH and PS well being), and the intro explaining the rational behind it
rows.ne: यहाँ उदाहरणका रूपमा गतिविधि 3.6 (बालबालिकाको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याणका लागि सामूहिक गतिविधि प्रदान गर्ने; MH, PS) र त्यसको औचित्य स्पष्ट पार्ने परिचय दिइएको छ।
rows.bt: Here, activity 3.6 (providing group activities for children's mental health and psychosocial well-being; MH, PS) and an introduction clarifying its rationale are given as an example.
rows.note: The activity name reuses the supplied unreviewed T103 candidate. The source abbreviations MH and PS are retained alongside the expanded candidate wording; domain review remains pending.

rows.en: Each activity is presented with:
rows.ne: प्रत्येक गतिविधिसँग निम्न सामग्री प्रस्तुत गरिन्छ:
rows.bt: The following materials are presented with each activity:

rows.en: A brief introduction
rows.ne: संक्षिप्त परिचय
rows.bt: Brief introduction

rows.en: A checklist of actions​
rows.ne: कार्यहरूको जाँचसूची
rows.bt: Checklist of actions

rows.en: Each activity also comes with:​
rows.ne: प्रत्येक गतिविधिसँग निम्न सामग्री पनि दिइएको छ:
rows.bt: Each activity is also provided with the following materials:

rows.en: A checklist of actions. ​
rows.ne: कार्यहरूको जाँचसूची।
rows.bt: Checklist of actions.

rows.en: These are the concrete steps that you need to take into account when planning and implementing an activity.
rows.ne: यी कुनै गतिविधिको योजना बनाउँदा र कार्यान्वयन गर्दा तपाईंले ध्यानमा राख्नुपर्ने ठोस चरणहरू हुन्।
rows.bt: These are concrete steps that you must keep in mind when planning and implementing an activity.

rows.en: The core actions ensure that the activity is implemented effectively and with quality. ​
rows.ne: मुख्य कार्यहरूले गतिविधिको प्रभावकारी र गुणस्तरीय कार्यान्वयन सुनिश्चित गर्छन्।
rows.bt: The key actions ensure effective and quality implementation of the activity.

rows.en: E.g.
rows.ne: उदाहरणका लागि,
rows.bt: For example,

rows.en: For providing group activities for children it tells you that you ​
rows.ne: बालबालिकाका लागि सामूहिक गतिविधि प्रदान गर्ने सन्दर्भमा, यसले तपाईंले गर्नुपर्ने काम यसरी बताउँछ:
rows.bt: In the context of providing group activities for children, it states what you must do as follows:
rows.note: The source is an unfinished lead-in continued by the following row; that relationship is retained.

rows.en: 1st need to identify appropriate content by reviewing the needs and resources within the community, eg by reviewing assessments & through participatory discussions​
rows.ne: 1st: समुदायभित्रका आवश्यकता र स्रोतहरूको समीक्षा गरेर उपयुक्त सामग्री पहिचान गर्नुपर्छ, उदाहरणका लागि लेखाजोखाको समीक्षा र सहभागितामूलक छलफलमार्फत।
rows.bt: 1st: You must identify appropriate materials by reviewing the needs and resources within the community, for example through a review of assessments and participatory discussions.
rows.note: The source ordinal token 1st is retained exactly.

rows.en: as a 2nd step you need to develop or adapt the training curricula and programme materials for the activiity​
rows.ne: 2 औँ चरणका रूपमा तपाईंले उक्त गतिविधिका लागि तालिमका पाठ्यक्रम र कार्यक्रम सामग्री विकास वा अनुकूलन गर्नुपर्छ।
rows.bt: As the 2nd step, you must develop or adapt training curricula and programme materials for that activity.
rows.note: Glossary proposals: training curricula = तालिमका पाठ्यक्रम; programme materials = कार्यक्रम सामग्री.

rows.en: it then reminds you that you should incorporate sessions for caregivers to share info on how emergencies affect children and on supporting caregiving practices; and so on.
rows.ne: त्यसपछि यसले तपाईंलाई आपत्कालीन अवस्थाले बालबालिकालाई कसरी असर गर्छ र हेरचाहका अभ्यासलाई कसरी सहयोग गर्ने भन्नेबारे जानकारी साझा गर्न हेरचाहकर्ताका लागि सत्रहरू समावेश गर्नु उचित हुन्छ भन्ने कुरा सम्झाउँछ; यस्तै अन्य कुराहरू पनि सम्झाउँछ।
rows.bt: Then it reminds you that it is appropriate to include sessions for caregivers to share information about how emergencies affect children and how to support caregiving practices; it also reminds you of other similar things.
rows.note: Revised the grammatical marking of emergencies and the closing phrase to preserve the source reminder without adding a requirement to include other topics. The source recommends that sessions should be incorporated; the back-translation says they need to be included. Revised the obligation wording to retain a recommendation rather than a requirement. The back-translation weakens the recommendation that you should incorporate caregiver sessions to a statement that including them is appropriate.

rows.en: As you can see, there is also a checklist of additional actions for consideration , these are additional steps that can also be prioritized for planning and implementation depending on context-specific needs and available resources. ​
rows.ne: तपाईंले देख्नुभएझैँ, विचार गर्नका लागि दिइएका थप कार्यहरू समेटिएको जाँचसूची पनि छ। यी थप कदमहरूलाई पनि सन्दर्भविशेषका आवश्यकता र उपलब्ध स्रोतहरूका आधारमा योजना तथा कार्यान्वयनका लागि प्राथमिकता दिन सकिन्छ।
rows.bt: As you have seen, there is also a checklist containing additional actions provided for consideration. These additional steps can also be prioritized for planning and implementation based on context-specific needs and available resources.

rows.en: Some activities include: Key considerations

rows.bt: Some activities include: key considerations

rows.en: Some activities also include key considerations – these are additional notes on topics that might be slightly complex or controversial, or for relatively new areas of work that people often ask more questions about.
rows.ne: केही गतिविधिमा मुख्य विचारणीय पक्षहरू पनि समावेश छन्। यी केही जटिल वा विवादास्पद हुन सक्ने विषयहरूबारे, वा मानिसहरूले प्रायः थप प्रश्न सोध्ने कामका तुलनात्मक रूपमा नयाँ क्षेत्रहरूबारे दिइएका थप टिप्पणी हुन्।
rows.bt: Some activities also include key considerations. These are additional comments provided on topics that may be somewhat complex or controversial, or on relatively new areas of work about which people often ask further questions.

rows.en: Some examples are the key considerations on:
rows.ne: केही उदाहरण निम्न विषयसँग सम्बन्धित मुख्य विचारणीय पक्षहरू हुन्:
rows.bt: Some examples are key considerations related to the following topics:

rows.en: A key consideration explains how MHPSS effectiveness is limited if a person's basic protection needs are not met - this can help you make the case for putting basic protections in place before trying to implement higher-level services.
rows.ne: एउटा मुख्य विचारणीय पक्षले कुनै व्यक्तिको संरक्षणसम्बन्धी आधारभूत आवश्यकता पूरा नभएमा MHPSS को प्रभावकारिता कसरी सीमित हुन्छ भन्ने स्पष्ट पार्छ। यसले तपाईंलाई उच्च तहका सेवाहरू कार्यान्वयन गर्ने प्रयास गर्नुअघि आधारभूत संरक्षणका व्यवस्था लागू गर्नुपर्ने पक्षमा तर्क प्रस्तुत गर्न मद्दत गर्न सक्छ।
rows.bt: One key consideration clarifies how the effectiveness of MHPSS is limited if a person's basic protection needs are not met. This can help you present an argument in favour of putting basic protection arrangements in place before attempting to implement higher-level services.
rows.note: Removed the incorrect T163 annotation: MSP does not occur in this row; MHPSS is retained as supplied. Nepali wording is unchanged. General protection guidance, not a verbatim safeguarding declaration; safety review is pending.

rows.en: For Workers supporting new and expectant caregivers and young children​
rows.ne: नयाँ हेरचाहकर्तालाई, बच्चाको आगमनको प्रतीक्षामा रहेका हेरचाहकर्तालाई र साना बालबालिकालाई सहयोग गर्ने कार्यकर्ताहरूका लागि
rows.bt: For workers who support new caregivers, caregivers awaiting the arrival of a child, and young children
rows.note: The draft interprets 'expectant caregivers' as caregivers awaiting a child; the source does not establish whether this includes anyone anticipating a caregiving role more broadly or specifically concerns an expected child, including during pregnancy. The BT makes new and expectant caregivers part of the intended audience and limits workers' support to young children. The source addresses workers supporting all three groups. Repeated object marking clarifies that relationship. “Expectant caregivers” is narrowed to caregivers awaiting a child’s arrival; the English leaves the nature of the anticipated caregiving role unspecified.
